pitch: A night-shift baker whose dough knows things

hero.name: Rosa

ability.name: Knead to Know
ability.text: Knead any dough and it rises into the shape of whatever is hiding nearby.

hero.flaw: Feeds everyone, including the thing she is supposed to be fighting.
hero.roast: Rosa has solved three mysteries with bread. She has never once slept.

visual.anchor: a round pear-shaped cartoon Latina baker woman in her fifties, flour smudged on her cheeks and forearms, a tall paper baker's hat, rolled-up sleeves, strong round arms
visual.outfit: a white baker's jacket dusted with flour and a faded red apron
visual.prop: a huge wooden rolling pin and a glowing lump of dough
visual.expression: warm grin, one eyebrow raised like she already knows

pitch: A crossing guard whose stop sign actually stops things

hero.name: Mr. Okafor

ability.name: Everybody Stop
ability.text: Raise the sign and anything moving freezes for three seconds.

hero.flaw: Cannot let anyone cross anything, including a room, without escorting them.
hero.roast: Mr. Okafor has stopped a runaway shopping cart, a tornado and his own retirement party.

visual.anchor: a very tall rectangle-shaped cartoon Nigerian-American man in his sixties, long arms, neat grey beard, a reflective cap, perfect posture
visual.outfit: a fluorescent yellow safety vest over a crisp white shirt and a bow tie
visual.prop: a big octagonal stop sign held high (blank, no letters)

pitch: A grandma who skates on anything

hero.name: Bea

ability.name: Grind Anything
ability.text: Skate on any surface: walls, railings, power lines, rooftops.

hero.flaw: Has never once taken the stairs, even inside a library.
hero.roast: Bea is 78 and has broken four bones. None of them hers.

visual.anchor: a tiny wiry triangle-shaped cartoon grandma in her late seventies, short silver pixie hair, big round glasses, knobbly knees in knee pads, sneakers
visual.outfit: a sticker-covered helmet, an oversized purple windbreaker and striped tube socks
visual.prop: a battered skateboard tucked under one arm
visual.expression: fearless smirk, ready to drop in

pitch: A mail carrier who knows where everything belongs

hero.name: Dmitri

ability.name: Return to Sender
ability.text: Knows where any lost object belongs, and can send it back there.

hero.flaw: Reads every postcard out loud, with feeling.
hero.roast: Dmitri has delivered mail through a blizzard and a haunting. Your package is still late.

visual.anchor: a stocky square-shaped cartoon Russian-American mail carrier in his forties, huge bushy mustache, thick calves, a pith-style mail helmet
visual.outfit: a blue-grey postal uniform with shorts in all weather and a stuffed leather satchel
visual.prop: a glowing envelope with no address
visual.expression: squinting, determined, slightly out of breath

pitch: A DJ whose bass drop shakes things loose

hero.name: DJ Kiko

ability.name: Drop the Beat
ability.text: One bass drop makes walls, floors and stubborn things wobble loose.

hero.flaw: Narrates every dramatic moment with an air horn noise.
hero.roast: Kiko has opened a locked vault with one song. It was a remix of the vault's alarm.

visual.anchor: a lanky bean-shaped cartoon Filipino DJ in their twenties, a two-tone buzz cut, giant headphones around the neck, tiny round sunglasses
visual.outfit: a cropped silver bomber jacket over a baggy tee and chunky platform sneakers
visual.expression: eyes closed, head bobbing, totally in the zone

pitch: A night nurse who can calm anything down

hero.name: Tamika

ability.name: Bedside Manner
ability.text: One calm sentence and anything panicking, from toddlers to poltergeists, settles down.

hero.flaw: Takes everyone's temperature, constantly, without asking.
hero.roast: Tamika has calmed a screaming ghost in under a minute. Her group chat, never.

visual.anchor: a sturdy round-shouldered cartoon Black nurse in her forties, a big puff of natural hair tied up with a scrunchie, reading glasses on her head, comfy clogs
visual.outfit: scrubs printed with tiny cartoon bandages and a stethoscope around her neck
visual.prop: a travel mug and a penlight

pitch: A street magician whose tricks are only 90% fake

hero.name: The Great Sal

ability.name: Pick a Card
ability.text: Whatever card someone picks shows the truth about them.

hero.flaw: Every trick goes about 90 percent right.
hero.roast: Sal pulled a real rabbit out of a real hat once. He has been apologizing to it since.

visual.anchor: a chubby egg-shaped cartoon Italian-American street magician in his fifties, slicked-back black hair with a grey streak, a pencil mustache, a short cape over a hoodie
visual.outfit: a moth-eaten velvet cape, a hoodie and a dented top hat
visual.prop: a fanned deck of playing cards (plain backs, no symbols)

pitch: A bus driver whose bus stops anywhere

hero.name: Marisol

ability.name: Next Stop
ability.text: Her bus can stop anywhere she says, even places that aren't on any map.

hero.flaw: Will not move until everyone is seated, even during a chase.
hero.roast: Marisol has never been late. Time is late to Marisol.

visual.anchor: a big broad rectangle-shaped cartoon Puerto Rican bus driver in her fifties, strong arms, a thick braid, aviator sunglasses pushed up on her head
visual.outfit: a transit uniform shirt with rolled sleeves and a lanyard of keys
visual.prop: a giant ring of keys and a coin changer
visual.expression: eyebrow raised, arms crossed, nobody messes with her bus

pitch: A librarian whose shush silences anything

hero.name: Mr. Han

ability.name: Shh
ability.text: One shush silences any sound within a block, even ones that shouldn't exist.

hero.flaw: Fines monsters for anything overdue, mid-fight.
hero.roast: Mr. Han has shushed a thunderstorm. It apologized.

visual.anchor: a thin tall-triangle-shaped cartoon Korean librarian in his seventies, neat white hair, round glasses on a beaded chain, very straight posture
visual.outfit: a mustard cardigan with elbow patches over a tie
visual.prop: a tall stack of old books and a rubber date stamp
visual.expression: one finger to his lips, eyes narrowed

pitch: A food truck chef whose hot sauce makes you tell the truth

hero.name: Nadia

ability.name: Secret Sauce
ability.text: Anyone, or anything, that tastes her hot sauce has to tell the truth.

hero.flaw: Rates everything anyone cooks, out loud, out of ten.
hero.roast: Nadia's sauce has cracked four cover-ups. It has also cracked two molars.

visual.anchor: an energetic pear-shaped cartoon Lebanese-Mexican food truck chef in her thirties, a bandana over curly hair, gold hoop earrings, a burn-scarred oven mitt on one hand
visual.outfit: a black chef's coat with sleeves rolled up and a stained apron
visual.prop: a squeeze bottle of glowing hot sauce and a giant spatula
visual.expression: confident grin, daring you to try it

pitch: A park ranger who can track anything, even the invisible

hero.name: Ranger Wren

ability.name: Track Anything
ability.text: Reads footprints, even invisible ones, and knows exactly what left them.

hero.flaw: Gives a full nature talk at the worst possible moment.
hero.roast: Wren once tracked a ghost for nine miles. The ghost filed a complaint.

visual.anchor: a tall lean cartoon Native American park ranger woman in her twenties, a long black braid, freckles, a plain flat-brimmed ranger hat with no feathers or decorations, hiking boots
visual.outfit: an olive ranger shirt with a blank patch and cargo shorts
visual.expression: crouched, focused, pointing at something only she can see

pitch: A teen chess champ who sees seven moves ahead

hero.name: Theo

ability.name: Seven Moves Ahead
ability.text: Sees how the next minute plays out if nobody changes anything.

hero.flaw: Says "checkmate" about things that are not checkmate.
hero.roast: Theo has predicted every move of a haunted chess set. He still loses rock-paper-scissors to his little sister.

visual.anchor: a skinny bean-shaped cartoon Black teen chess prodigy, age thirteen, short neat twists, a small confident closed-mouth smirk, an oversized school blazer with sleeves too long
visual.outfit: an oversized navy blazer over a hoodie, a lanyard tournament badge (blank)
visual.prop: a chess knight piece and a chess clock
visual.expression: calm and smug, one eyebrow up, already three steps ahead
